description: This PHP script manages saving and duplicating Access Control List (ACL) roles within SuiteCRM. It handles creating new role objects, updating roles with posted data, cloning role actions if duplication is requested, and setting permissions based on form input.

classes.name: ACLRoles
classes.description: Represents a role used in access control within SuiteCRM, providing methods for role management, including retrieving role actions and setting permissions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current role object to the database.

methods.name: getRoleActions
methods.description: Retrieves actions associated with a role, used for duplicating permissions.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Assigns a specific action permission to the role.
